answer_1.quote: We train the models on 120B and 400B high-quality tokens, encompassing multilingual, math, and general knowledge content.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate text in zero-shot settings on benchmarks covering code, math, general knowledge, and language proficiency.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation We mainly test the zero-shot capabilities on four popular benchmarks, including En-glish, Hellaswag , general knowledge MMLU , math GSM8k , and Chinese proficiency C-eval .
